faq.q: Why is German B1 important for work and visas?
faq.a: Many applications for vocational training (Ausbildung), jobs and residence in German-speaking countries ask for B1 German or higher. Always check the exact requirement of your own application.

faq.q: What does the Goethe-Zertifikat B1 exam test?
faq.a: The Goethe B1 exam has four modules: Lesen, Hören, Schreiben and Sprechen. From B1 the exam is modular, so you can take the modules together or separately. We run timed mock tests for every module.

faq.q: Is the German B1 course in Dehradun good for nursing and Ausbildung applicants?
faq.a: Yes. Our German B1 course in Dehradun builds the speaking, letter writing and workplace vocabulary that nursing, Ausbildung and job applicants need, and prepares you for the Goethe-Zertifikat B1.

faq.q: How much speaking practice is there in the B1 course?
faq.a: Every B1 class includes speaking tasks such as discussions, short presentations and role plays, because the Sprechen module is where many learners need the most practice.

faq.q: Can I take German B1 classes online?
faq.a: Yes. German B1 classes run online and at our Race Course centre in Dehradun, with morning, evening and personalised batches.
